# hhi_panel manifest

## Files covered
- btc_1m_panel_with_hhi
- btc_1m_panel_with_hhi_excl_binance
- btc_1m_panel_with_hhi_excl_binance_audit
- hhi_trend_summary
- HHIroll_quintile_future_return

## Original path
D:\click here\2代目\hhi_panel

## Description
This folder contains the synchronized minute-level concentration panel built from exchange-level dollar-volume shares. It includes baseline and Binance-exclusion versions of the concentration panel, as well as summary outputs based on HHI and rolling concentration proxies.

## Time range
2021–2022, one-minute BTCUSD synchronized panel.

## Key variables
Typical panel-level fields include:
- dominant_exchange
- max_share
- HHI
- HHI_roll
- aggregate price series
- concentration-state objects used for robustness and descriptive summaries

## Generated by
- build_hhi_trend_panel.py
- make_panel_excl_exchange_from_dv.py

## Used in paper
These files support the concentration-state analysis described in the main paper and appendix. In the paper, concentration is linked to LWMP pivot behavior, VWAP proximity to the dominant exchange, threshold robustness, year-based subsamples, and Binance-exclusion checks.

## File status
The large minute-level panel files are not included in the GitHub repository because of file-size constraints. Summary outputs and small metadata files are retained elsewhere in the repository.

## Actual storage location
Currently stored locally.

## Notes
This folder is an intermediate but central layer in the empirical pipeline. Users interested in reproducing concentration-based robustness should reconstruct this panel from the exchange-level DV files and the build scripts.
